home.title: Trade from your own wallet
home.subtitle: Connect a wallet, trade spot and perpetuals through decentralized exchanges, and keep custody of your assets the whole time. FLT never holds your keys and never touches your funds.

landing.title: Trade on decentralized exchanges without handing over your assets.
landing.subtitle: FLT routes your order across on-chain liquidity and builds the transaction. Your wallet signs it, the blockchain settles it, and your funds never pass through us. We never ask for a seed phrase or a private key, because we never need one.

steps.title: Connect your wallet
steps.body: Link a self-custody wallet by signing a message. No transfer, no deposit, no gas.

steps.title: Review the route
steps.body: See the expected output, the guaranteed minimum, price impact, every fee, and the contract being called.

steps.title: Sign it yourself
steps.body: Your wallet signs and broadcasts. FLT holds no keys and cannot move your funds.

steps.title: Settle on-chain
steps.body: We watch the transaction and record what actually happened, not what we expected.

landing.whatWeDontDoIntro: Being clear about the limits matters more than a feature list. FLT is deliberately not a centralized exchange, and several things you may expect from one are absent by design.
landing.perpsAddendum: Perpetual futures are available to verified accounts and are leveraged products: they can be closed automatically and you can lose the margin backing them.
dontDoItems: We do not hold your assets, so there is no FLT balance to withdraw.
We do not operate an order book and cannot match your trade internally.
We cannot reverse a transaction. Once your wallet signs, it is on-chain.
We do not custody your assets, so there is nothing here for us to lend against or lose.
We never request a seed phrase, private key or wallet password — nobody legitimate ever will.
landing.disclaimer: Digital assets are volatile and you can lose money. Trades settle on public blockchains and cannot be reversed once signed. FLT-Exchange provides an interface to decentralized liquidity; it does not provide investment advice and does not take custody of client assets.

plans.title: Plans
plans.subtitle: Fee discounts, higher leverage and longer history. Protection is available to everyone regardless of plan.
plans.description: Tools, limits and cheaper trading. Protection is never gated — every account sees the calculation.
plans.lockedBanner: You can't place trades until you activate a plan.
plans.onPlanUntil: You are on {plan} until {date}. Buying another plan adds the days you have left to the new period.
plans.breakEven: Pays for itself at {amount} of monthly volume.
plans.connectWalletBody: A plan is paid by a transfer you sign yourself.
plans.footerNote: Plans are paid one period at a time and do not renew automatically — FLT holds no key that could charge you again, which is the same reason it cannot move your trading funds. When a period ends the account returns to Free; positions, history and protection policies are untouched.
plans.cancelNote: Cancelling stops the plan but does not refund the current period.
plans.activeUntil: {plan} is active until {date}. Nothing will renew automatically.
plans.declined: You declined the transfer, so nothing was charged.
plans.genericError: Something went wrong and no plan was started.

upgrade.generalDetail: Advanced analytics, higher leverage and up to 25% off trading fees.
upgrade.onPaidPlanTitle: You are on a paid plan
upgrade.onPaidPlanBody: Your fee discount is applied to every trade automatically.
upgrade.payForItselfTitle: Does a plan pay for itself?
upgrade.tradeCountPrefix: You have made {count} trade in the last 90 days.
upgrade.tradeCountPrefixPlural: You have made {count} trades in the last 90 days.
upgrade.enterVolume: Enter what you trade in a typical month and this works out the rest at the current {bps} bps fee.
upgrade.worthItNotice: At {volume} a month, {plan} pays for itself and leaves {net} over.
upgrade.notWorthItNotice: At {volume} a month the fee discount alone would not cover a subscription. A plan is still worth it for the leverage ceiling or the analytics — but not for the discount.
upgrade.cappedBody: Free accounts get spot, perpetuals, every chart and the protection calculation — but leverage stops at {n}x. That is the limit most people meet first.
upgrade.footerNote: Protection is never behind a plan — every account sees the calculation and can buy cover. Plans pay for the software. Nothing renews automatically.

protection.needsPlanBody: Look around as much as you like — prices, charts and the protection calculation are all live. Placing an order needs FLT Basic or above.

referrals.title: Referrals
referrals.subtitle: Share your code. You earn 20% of FLT's revenue from anyone who trades using it.
referrals.codeExplainer: Anyone who uses it gets {days} days of {tier} free. You earn {pct}% of what FLT makes from them — trading fees and subscriptions — for as long as they trade.
referrals.connectFirst: Connect and verify a wallet first — that is where earnings are paid.
referrals.nothingEarnedYet: Nothing earned yet. A share is recorded whenever somebody you referred pays a trading fee or buys a plan.
referrals.earningsFooter: Earnings are recorded per trade and per payment, so every figure can be itemised. They are amounts owed rather than a balance held — FLT keeps no float — and a trading-fee share is denominated in whatever token the fee was taken in, which is why these are not added together.
referrals.joinedWith: You joined with {code} on {date}. A code can only be used once per account.
referrals.redeemFor: Redeem it for {days} days of {tier}, free. One per account, ever.
referrals.oneLevelFooter: One level only. You earn from the people you refer and from nobody else — there is no second tier, and referring somebody who refers somebody earns you nothing from the third person.

passiveCash.title: Passive cash account
passiveCash.description: Idle cash is used in FLT's market-making. You keep {profitPct}% of any profit and bear {lossPct}% of any loss. It is withdrawable at any time.
passiveCash.notOperationalBody: The market-making book has no execution on this deployment, so money contributed here could not be put to work. Taking it anyway would be charging for a service that does not run.
passiveCash.dialogIntro: This is different from everything else on FLT. Your trading balance never leaves your wallet. This does. Read each point and tick it.
passiveCash.termsVersion: Terms version {version}. If these change you will be asked to read them again.

walletsPage.title: Wallets
walletsPage.description: Self-custody wallets linked to your account. Your keys never leave your device, and FLT cannot move your funds.
walletsPage.noWalletBody: Link a self-custody wallet by signing a message. It costs no gas and does not authorise any spending.
walletsPage.previouslyLinkedBody: These addresses are no longer linked. Their transaction history is retained — unlinking a wallet does not unmake the trades signed with it.
walletsPage.howLinkingWorksBody: Connecting a wallet lets your browser talk to it. Linking goes one step further: you sign a short message proving you control the address, which is what lets FLT show your balances and attribute your transactions. The signature is not a transaction, costs no gas, and grants no spending permission.

accountPage.saveRecoveryCodesDesc: Each code works once, if you lose access to your authenticator. They are stored only as hashes, so this is the only time they can be shown.
accountPage.twoFactorDesc: A second factor protects your account even if your password is stolen.
